#!/usr/bin/env python3
import pandas as pd
import hopsworks

# Read the data
train_df = pd.read_csv('data/features_train.csv')
serve_df = pd.read_csv('data/features_serve.csv')

# Compute mean and std (population) from training data only
stats = {}
for col in ['f1', 'f2', 'f3', 'f4']:
    mean = train_df[col].mean()
    std = train_df[col].std(ddof=0)  # population std
    stats[col] = {'mean': mean, 'std': std}

# Standardize both splits
for df, split_name in [(train_df, 'train'), (serve_df, 'serve')]:
    df['split'] = split_name

# Standardize features
def standardize(value, mean, std):
    return round((value - mean) / std, 6)

for col in ['f1', 'f2', 'f3', 'f4']:
    mean = stats[col]['mean']
    std = stats[col]['std']
    train_df[col] = train_df[col].apply(lambda x: standardize(x, mean, std))
    serve_df[col] = serve_df[col].apply(lambda x: standardize(x, mean, std))

# Combine both splits
combined_df = pd.concat([train_df, serve_df], ignore_index=True)

# Reorder columns: row_id, split, f1, f2, f3, f4
combined_df = combined_df[['row_id', 'split', 'f1', 'f2', 'f3', 'f4']]

print("Combined DataFrame shape:", combined_df.shape)
print("First few rows:")
print(combined_df.head())
print("\nLast few rows:")
print(combined_df.tail())

# Connect to Hopsworks and register the feature table
print("\nConnecting to Hopsworks...")
hopsworks.login()

# Get the feature store
fs = hopsworks.feature_store()

# Create a feature group
fg_name = "scalede10147"
fg_version = 1

# Check if feature group exists, if not create it
try:
    fg = fs.get_feature_group(fg_name, version=fg_version)
    print(f"Feature group {fg_name} v{fg_version} already exists")
except:
    # Create the feature group
    fg = fs.create_feature_group(
        name=fg_name,
        version=fg_version,
        primary_key=["row_id"],
        description="Standardized features from training and serving splits"
    )
    print(f"Created feature group {fg_name} v{fg_version}")

# Save the DataFrame to a temporary CSV
combined_df.to_csv('combined_features.csv', index=False)

# Upload to feature store
print("\nUploading data to feature store...")
fg.save(combined_df)

print("\nFeature table registered successfully!")
print(f"Feature group: {fg_name}, version: {fg_version}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import pandas as pd
import hopsworks

# Read the data
train_df = pd.read_csv('data/features_train.csv')
serve_df = pd.read_csv('data/features_serve.csv')

# Compute mean and std (population) from training data only
stats = {}
for col in ['f1', 'f2', 'f3', 'f4']:
    mean = train_df[col].mean()
    std = train_df[col].std(ddof=0)  # population std
    stats[col] = {'mean': mean, 'std': std}
    print(f'{col}: mean={mean:.10f}, std={std:.10f}')

# Add split column
train_df['split'] = 'train'
serve_df['split'] = 'serve'

# Standardize features using training statistics
def standardize(value, mean, std):
    return round((value - mean) / std, 6)

for col in ['f1', 'f2', 'f3', 'f4']:
    mean = stats[col]['mean']
    std = stats[col]['std']
    train_df[col] = train_df[col].apply(lambda x: standardize(x, mean, std))
    serve_df[col] = serve_df[col].apply(lambda x: standardize(x, mean, std))

# Combine both splits
combined_df = pd.concat([train_df, serve_df], ignore_index=True)

# Reorder columns: row_id, split, f1, f2, f3, f4
combined_df = combined_df[['row_id', 'split', 'f1', 'f2', 'f3', 'f4']]

print("\nCombined DataFrame shape:", combined_df.shape)
print("First few rows:")
print(combined_df.head(10))
print("\nLast few rows:")
print(combined_df.tail(10))

# Connect to Hopsworks
print("\nConnecting to Hopsworks...")
hopsworks.login()

# Get the feature store
proj = hopsworks.get_current_project()
fs = proj.get_feature_store()

# Create or get the feature group
fg_name = "scalede10147"
fg_version = 1

print(f"\nCreating/updating feature group {fg_name} v{fg_version}...")
fg = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
    name=fg_name,
    version=fg_version,
    primary_key=["row_id"],
    online_enabled=True,  # Enable low-latency lookup
    description="Standardized features from training and serving splits"
)

print(f"Feature group created: {fg.name} v{fg.version}, online_enabled={fg.online_enabled}")

# Save the data
print("\nSaving data to feature store...")
fg.save(combined_df, wait=True)

print("\nFeature table registered successfully!")
print(f"Feature group: {fg_name}, version: {fg_version}")
print(f"Online enabled: {fg.online_enabled}")
